claim: Endpoint registrations reject conflicting live specs, share identical users through leases, distinguish owned/adopted entries, and asynchronously release cancelled acquisitions.
Discovery identity and event-plane transport are explicit types; event transport choice does not identify every request or discovery path.
LocalEndpointRegistry resolves local engine objects separately from remote discovery and serialization.
HTTP input construction distinguishes dynamic model watching from directly registered in-process engines.
The frontend links preprocessor, migration, token backend, encoder and prefill forward edges, then corresponding backward edges in reverse order.
Completion handling resolves canonical model identity, creates request context/guards, obtains an engine stream, and preflights its first item before protocol commitment.
Connection handles send configured on-drop signals while armed/disarmed ownership follows handler and response-stream lifetimes.
Prompt tokens are Arc-backed with serialization helpers; migration_state and staged_kv_cleanup remain frontend-local serde-skipped bookkeeping.
Engine-owned disaggregated_params and framework-owned worker_trace_link are separate wire fields with distinct owners.
Query performs queue admission without booking, Book installs a reservation, Lease returns caller-owned armed booking, and Advisory skips admission.
ReservationClaim installs committed booking and affinity lease atomically relative to its claim and drops uncommitted claims on error/cancellation.
Worker membership/deletion interacts with partitions and live booking cleanup rather than treating a reused worker ID as uninterrupted ownership.
Selection tests cover worker deletion cleanup, same-ID return, indexer/affinity errors and reachability-dependent cache transfer hints.
Cache events are normalized before application and gap handling has its own cursor/replay lifecycle.
Tiered lookup tests prohibit side-only predictions from becoming confirmed lower-tier anchors and avoid double-counting device/lower-tier overlap.
RequestBlockChain is not Clone; tracker ownership survives compressed-tree splits and dropping one owner preserves surviving handles.
Worker startup derives/publishes effective engine cache/scheduling limits; optional KVBM consolidator setup depends on selected connector.
KVBM detection recognizes DynamoConnector directly or nested in PdConnector; legacy connector configuration is translated separately.
build_sampling_params applies selected model defaults/request precedence; _DeferredAbort retains/shields real abort and separately cancels parked pre-first-output waiters.
NIXL pull, Mooncake push, and cache-mediated connector strategies produce different stage-continuation contracts.
Deferred-abort tests distinguish pre-first-output intent, later actual abort, and safe waiter close when output never arrives.
PrefillRouter tests preserve staged-KV cleanup obligations and independent prefill context across client cancellation.
Handoff composition separates required prefill metadata from generated tokens and observes stage failures during decode/cleanup.
DynamoConnector splits leader/worker hooks and binds generic connector metadata so layer callbacks can execute.
Leader metadata construction and request-finished retention form a separate contract from engine block deallocation.
KVBM worker registers tensor/event layouts, records current-stream events before save, and reports completion before retained blocks can retire.
KVBM guard types encode Reset/Staged/Registered transitions and return originating blocks in transition errors.
Planner decision uses config lock/generation, admission rechecks generation, one unacknowledged submission is shielded, and unknown outcomes hold later automatic effects.
Runtime patches validate instance/revision/idempotent intent, prepare predictor changes before activation, and recheck under admission/config locks.
Reactive load scaling uses explicit missing-data, capacity-mismatch, scaling-in-progress and budget/floor guards.
Predictive throughput scaling uses traffic/performance estimates with bounded capacity changes rather than a universal queue threshold.
Runtime reconfiguration tests assert conditional/idempotent scalar updates preserve live state and distinguish preparation failure from activation.
HTTP queue includes prefill before first generation; input add versus observe uses different semantics, and first positive token output changes request accounting phase.
Frontend load frames replace prior snapshots within an incarnation and distinguish gauges from cumulative counters.
Forward-pass wall_time approximates execution through scheduler/update boundaries, with special first-idle behavior and zero-valued heartbeat duration.
Strict tool-schema and unsupported grammar/choice request cases are rejected before backend dispatch in the HTTP test harness.
HTTP metrics tests cover rejected/failed paths and bounded unknown-model labeling, not only successful token streams.
